verify.note: Closed 2026-09-29 (ADR-1641). Loads next.config.ts through Next’s own config loader and route normaliser, compiles each header source to the routes-manifest regex, and asserts per path: /scan, /scan/ and /SCAN get exactly one Permissions-Policy with camera=(self); /, /feed, /partners/acme, /scanner, /events/scan and /n/node-1 get exactly one with camera=(); all keep microphone=() and geolocation=(self). Also fails if the scanner asks for the camera before its soft-navigation re-load check. Fails on main at /scan camera=(). Mutation-fired: overlapping rules (2 values), site-wide (self), microphone or geolocation changed, the lookahead without the trailing slash, the re-load removed. Exits 79 if the scanner stops calling getUserMedia.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1641). PER ROUTE, ONE RULE PER PATH: next.config.ts serves /scan "camera=(self), microphone=(), geolocation=(self)" and every other path "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(self)". The default rule EXCLUDES the camera routes by a lookahead source (/:path((?!(?:scan)/?$).*)) rather than leaning on "the last matching header wins", so no path is matched by two Permissions-Policy rules and no proxy can send two lines. CAMERA_ROUTES is the list; the stale "camera/microphone are never used" comment is gone. SOFT NAVIGATION: a policy is fixed when a document loads and a <Link> into /scan keeps the starting document (camera=()), so the scanner reads document.permissionsPolicy (or featurePolicy) before asking and, when it refuses the camera and the document was not loaded at this path, re-loads /scan as its own document once (lib/scan/camera-policy.ts; the navigation timing entry is the loop guard). SWEEP: getUserMedia has one caller (components/scan/scanner.tsx); capture= file inputs and the poster QR decode are not governed by the policy; nothing records audio, so microphone stays (); geolocation stays (self) site-wide (maps, Near me, node claim, live location, timezone card). VERIFIED on Next 16.3.6's server with the real headers(): /scan one line camera=(self), /, /feed, /scanner one line camera=(). TESTS: scripts/permissions-policy.test.ts (Next's loader, route normaliser and routes-manifest regex, per path), lib/scan/camera-policy.test.ts, and test/e2e/scan-camera.spec.ts (390px, fake camera: the header, a direct open, and a soft navigation that re-loads and runs the viewfinder).
